dogecoin.text: @unusual_whales Looks like the DOGECOIN is rising under Trump’s Department of Government Efficiency—literally and financially.

@WatcherGuru .In August 2024, a U.S. District Judge dismissed a $258 billion lawsuit alleging Elon Musk manipulated Dogecoin’s value, citing lack of evidence.

.Following the dismissal, investors withdrew their appeal and related legal motions, effectively ending the case against Musk.
